source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "ride-hailing" OR "ride hailing" OR ridesourcing OR "ride-sourcing" OR (ridesharing AND urban)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"ride-hailing" OR "ride hailing" OR ridesourcing OR "ride-sourcing" OR (ridesharing AND urban),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("ride hailing" OR "ride-hailing" OR "ride-sourcing" OR "ridesourcing" OR ("ridesharing" AND "urban"))
